text.K-2: Hi! This is Wilmington, a real town in Ohio. Let's look around!
text.3-5: Welcome to Wilmington, Ohio. Every building, road and tree here comes from real map data.
text.6-8: This is a 3D model of Wilmington, Ohio, built from real map data: every building, road and creek.
text.9-12: This is a 3D model of Wilmington, Ohio, built from open map data (Overture Maps / OpenStreetMap). Footprints are real; heights are exaggerated 3x.

text.K-2: Here is a school! Kids learn here, just like you.
text.6-8: Here's the school closest to the town center. Schools get money from local property taxes, which matters later.

text.K-2: This tall thing is a water tower. It holds water for the town.
text.3-5: A water tower stores clean water up high so it can flow to homes.
text.9-12: Water towers store treated water at height, so gravity keeps pressure in the pipes.

text.K-2: This is where electricity comes into town.
text.3-5: This is a power substation. Big power lines bring electricity here for the town.
text.9-12: A substation steps high-voltage transmission power down to distribution voltage for local lines.

steps.text: That's the town tour! Next, we'll find out what a data center is.
